$comment: §L-850 — THE DARK-TEST-FILE LEDGER. Named, shrink-only, checked in BOTH directions.
A row here is a test file that NO runner can select: it exists, it reads as coverage,
and it asserts nothing. L-849 is the founding case — packages/geometry-lift ran 11 tests
that had never executed, because its include matched neither the package-root directory
nor the .test.ts suffix. The gate that reads this file is
tools/ga-gate/check-no-dark-test-files.ts.
RULES (C70 §5.3):
1. This file may only SHRINK. Wiring a file up means DELETING its row in the SAME
commit — the gate exits 3 (STALE) if a row stops being measured and stays here.
2. A new dark file exits 3 (RATCHET EXCEEDED). Do NOT add a row to go green.
Adding a row is only legal when a row is being MOVED (e.g. a path rename) or when
the founder has explicitly decided to tolerate a newly-discovered one.
3. NEVER enable a dark suite without measuring it in isolation first. The L-849
protocol: run it under a THROWAWAY config; GREEN means widening the include asserts
nothing new and is safe; RED means it is a FINDING for the founder, not a chore —
enabling it would break the build. Every row below records which it was.
CLASSES:
no-runner          nothing includes it. The L-849 shape.
excluded-by        a runner includes it and that runner`s `exclude` removes it again —
a DELIBERATE quarantine of a suite measured RED. Kept visible here
on purpose: a quarantine that vanishes from the count is a deletion
with extra steps.
compiled-artefact  checked-in tsc output beside its .ts source. Do NOT enable it; stop
committing build output.
unproven-coverage  C70 §2.2 — the only candidate runner could not be read, so the gate
did NOT measure this file as dark and does not claim it is.
SCOPE: GLOB REACHABILITY, not CI INVOCATION. A file absent from this ledger can still be
run by no CI job — that axis is scripts/check/check-test-ci-coverage.mjs.
HISTORY — 2026-08-14 (§L-850, founder-approved): 137 -> 65 -> 13. The 57 files under
tests/{parity,contract-44,ci,visual-diff,playwright} belonged to NO RUNNER AT ALL — not a
missed include (there was nothing to widen), but no invocation that could select them. All 56
vitest-family files were measured in isolation FIRST, under a throwaway config held OUTSIDE the
repo so this gate’s own runner census could not see it: 398 tests, 374 pass, 24 fail, 4 files RED.
24 of the green files WROTE A SNAPSHOT ON FIRST RUN — an unreviewed baseline, not a pass — and each
was reviewed by recomputing its payload independently from the harness tables (hand-transcribed, not
imported, so the check is not circular) before the baseline was committed; 24/24 matched.
vitest.suites.config.ts + the root `test:suites` script + the `test-suites` ci.yml job then claimed
the 52 green files. The 4 RED files and the 1 green-but-VACUOUS Playwright scaffold stayed here,
each beside its actual reason.
recipe: every **/*.{test,spec}.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs} outside node_modules/dist, matched against the include (minus exclude) of every runner: root vitest.config.ts, vitest.server.config.ts, every playwright.config.*, the root `--test` scripts parsed out of package.json, every vitest/vite config in every pnpm-workspace.yaml workspace, and vitest`s DEFAULT include for a workspace that runs vitest with no config of its own. Include patterns resolve against `root:` if declared, else the config`s own dir when a sibling package.json exists, else the repo root.

dark.tests/playwright/phase-c/_phase-c.spec.t: [no-runner] §L-850 — MEASURED 2026-08-14 and DELIBERATELY NOT CLAIMED, for a reason that is neither green nor red. Run in isolation under a throwaway Playwright config (chromium, no webServer): 33 passed / 0 failed in 28.9s. But EVERY body is `expect(page).toBeTruthy()` — the file is the S70 Phase-C scaffold, its `@playwright/test` import still carries `// @ts-expect-error — will be added in Phase H`, and each stub names a `runtime.persistence.*` gesture that is NOT exercised. Claiming it would print 33 Phase-C gestures as covered while asserting nothing about any of them — the exact §CONTEXT-DATA-HONESTY shape this ledger exists to stop, and it would cost ~29s x 3 browsers per CI run to assert it. Root playwright.config.ts has `testDir: ./tests/e2e`, so claiming it also means widening that testDir or adding a second Playwright config. FOUNDER DECISION, not a chore: fill the bodies in, or delete the scaffold. Until then the row stands.
